jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

You are the day-to-day point of contact on the production floor, making sure the team knows what needs to be done. You keep a close eye on both the employees and the production process.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
You lead and coach a team of approximately 15 employees within the manual packaging department.

 
• 
You organise the daily activities and ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, food safety and hygiene.

 
• 
You keep track of production planning and staffing levels and make adjustments when necessary.

 
• 
You identify operational bottlenecks and look for ways to improve efficiency and productivity.

 
• 
You motivate employees, provide feedback and address issues when necessary.

 
• 
You contribute to strong teamwork and a positive working atmosphere.

 
• 
You support new colleagues during their onboarding and training.

 
• 
You work closely with other departments and report on daily operations.

 
• 
When the situation requires it, you are happy to roll up your sleeves and work alongside the team on the production floor.

You keep a cool head when plans change and understand what your team needs to keep moving forward. You are visible and approachable on the production floor, provide clear direction and make adjustments where necessary. Sound like you? Then this could be your dream job!

 
• 
You have experience in the food industry, preferably within a production or packaging environment.

 
• 
Previous experience in a supervisory or team-leading role is a strong advantage.

 
• 
You know how to motivate and coach employees and provide clear, constructive feedback.

 
• 
You communicate clearly, respectfully and assertively.

 
• 
When organising the work, you take both quality and efficiency into account.

 
• 
You are able to set priorities and organise daily activities effectively.

 
• 
You take responsibility and show initiative.

 
• 
Changing circumstances sometimes require quick adjustments, and you are able to respond accordingly.

 
• 
You enjoy being present on the production floor and are willing to work alongside the team when needed.

 
• 
You work daytime hours, but are flexible when necessary.

 
• 
You have a good language of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate effectively with colleagues and supervisors.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• Supervise and coordinate the packaging team during the night shift.

• Ensure that packaging activities are carried out efficiently and according to production planning.

• Follow and maintain the work schedule

• Lead and coordinate team members

• Actively contribute to the work on the floor

• Work responsibly, flexibly, and independently

 

 

Requirements:

• Previous experience in a packaging, production, or supervisory role.

• Strong organizational and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

• Willingness to work night shifts.

• Experience in a food production or manufacturing environment is an advantage.

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Join our team
 

We are a restaurant awarded 
1 Michelin star and are looking for a motivated and passionate 
cook to join our kitchen team.
 

Quality, product knowledge, precision and teamwork are at the heart of our kitchen. We work with high-quality ingredients every day and strive to offer our guests a gastronomic experience at the highest level.
 

As a cook, you will have an important role within our team and contribute to the daily operation of the kitchen.
 

As a cook, you will:
 
 

•  

be responsible for your own section of the kitchen;
  

•  

prepare the mise en place and preparations for your section;
  

•  

prepare and plate dishes according to our standards;
  

•  

ensure consistent quality, taste and presentation;
  

•  

work closely with the chef and the rest of the kitchen team;
  

•  

ensure an efficient and well-organised service;
  

•  

work according to hygiene and HACCP standards;
  

•  

take proper care of ingredients, equipment and your workstation;
  

•  

actively contribute to the efficient organisation and operation of the kitchen.
  
 

•  

You have 
at least 2 years of relevant professional experience as a cook, or can demonstrate equivalent relevant knowledge and experience.
  

•  

You are organised and able to work accurately.
  

•  

You have a strong eye for detail, quality and presentation.
  

•  

You can work both independently and as part of a team.
  

•  

You speak 
Dutch or English.
  

•  

You are able to travel independently to the 
Knokke region, Belgium.

As a Network Designer within Fiber your responsibilities are: 

• Analyse the impact of internal and external triggers on the network architecture, with a focus on large to very large projects
• Consult inventory databases and other available network information as the basis for your study
• Develop a high-level or detailed design plan that describes the solution in concrete terms
• Optimise the network and keep its complexity as limited as possible
• Monitor investment and operating costs and lower them wherever possible
• Safeguard the buildability of the network, so that design and execution fit together smoothly
• Ensure the design, management and maintenance of the cable network in your region and follow up large-scale projects from start to finish

What do you bring?

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, surveying, geography or a similar field
• Experience in the telecom sector
• Experience with road works and/or utility works is a strong asset
Your skills

• Good knowledge of QGIS (a must), AutoCAD or similar tools
• Good knowledge of MS Office
• Strong spatial awareness; you quickly recognise patterns in networks and maps
• An analytical mindset when approaching technical issues
• Professional communication skills in Dutch and English
Who are you?

• You work independently and organise and prioritise your work with ease
• You combine analytical insight with a practical view on feasibility
• You are flexible and stress-resistant, even when projects become large and complex
• You stay positive and constructive, even under difficult circumstances

Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

Would you like to join an international company on a human scale in Brussels and gain valuable professional experience? We are looking for a versatile Travel & Customer Care Assistant to support the DiscoverEU team in delivering smooth travel coordination and high-quality participant support. Key Responsibilities Travel & Customer Care
 
 
 
• Respond promptly to participant enquiries via email and chat, ensuring agreed service levels are met 
 
• Coordinate travel logistics, including booking support, document verification, and expense/invoice tracking 
 
• Identify and escalate complex cases to the appropriate team members when required 
 
• Manage special travel situations (e.g. accessibility needs, lost tickets, rebookings) and maintain accurate records 
 
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, data protection rules, and financial guidelines 
 
• Support administrative tasks and team coordination as needed 
 
• Troubleshoot participant documentation issues and follow escalation processes 
 

 Admin, IT & Tools
 
 
 
• Use internal platforms and helpdesk tools to efficiently assist participants 
 
• Work with databases, IT systems, and standard office tools 
 
• Ensure all data handling complies with GDPR and internal IT security protocols 
 
• Promote sustainability principles as part of EMAS commitments 

 
 
•   
 
• Available between June and August (with extension until September–October for German and/or Polish speakers) 
 
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken) 
 
• Good written skills in German, Dutch, and/or Polish (German and Polish are strong assets) 
 
• Strong customer service mindset and professional communication skills 
 
• Well-organised, able to manage priorities and meet deadlines 
 
• Detail-oriented, with a focus on quality, accuracy, and consistency 
 
•

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

Profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

You will join an international finance environment with operations across several European countries. Based in the Brussels region, the accounting team supports multiple entities and works closely with controlling, business finance, and external advisors. English serves as the primary working language.

This Senior Accountant position goes beyond traditional accounting. You will take on a central role in the month-end closing process, bring structure to complex accounting operations, and have the opportunity to drive digitalization, automation, and process improvement initiatives.

Senior accountant - Job omschrijving

• You independently manage the month-end closing process, maintain oversight of the end-to-end accounting cycle, and contribute to the development of an efficient finance organization.
• You lead process improvement initiatives across accounting, reporting, and audit activities, while actively supporting digitalization, automation, and optimization projects.
• You act as a key business partner for colleagues and external stakeholders, analyze financial risks, and support complex matters related to taxation, reporting, and international operations.

Senior accountant - Profiel

• You have 5 to 7 years of experience in accounting, audit, consulting, or a similar financial environment, with proven exposure to complex closing processes.
• You combine a strong knowledge of Belgian accounting legislation with the maturity and autonomy required to manage financial processes and dossiers independently.
• You are a hands-on generalist who takes initiative, identifies improvement opportunities, and enjoys taking ownership within an international environment.

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst to support the design and continuous improvement of processes and tools for both individual and professional customers in Finance/insurance.
Key responsibilities

• Business Analysis: Gather, analyze, prioritize and document business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, user stories and process flows.

• Process Optimization: Assess existing processes, identify improvement opportunities and contribute to digital transformation initiatives, including partner portals, automation and self-service solutions.

• Solution Design & Implementation: Work closely with business, IT, architecture, operations and compliance teams to design suitable solutions, support user acceptance testing (UAT) and facilitate change management.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Organize workshops and presentations, engage key stakeholders and ensure that transformation initiatives meet business objectives.

• Agile Delivery: Actively contribute to team activities, backlog management and Agile ceremonies, promoting Agile values and principles.

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst (+ 5 years).

• Bachelor in information technology, software engineering, computer science, or related field

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies, backlog management tools and team ceremonies.

• Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to understand diverse stakeholder needs while maintaining a global perspective.

• Ability to engage stakeholders, influence decisions and build commitment.

• Fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

Blue Pimento Company Profile

Dynamic Consultancy services firm with a human scale, based in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, Blue Pimento is dedicated to development and deployment of business-oriented platforms. We help mid-sized companies in maximizing the business value of their information systems changes.

The success of Blue Pimento is based on Quality & Flexibility of the work performed by its consultants and most of the repeating assignments results from our customer's confidence.

Take ownership of scalable web applications, shape technical architecture and build robust solutions with PHP, Symfony & Vue.js.

Our partner is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to strengthen its development team.

You will work on scalable web applications, contribute to key architectural decisions and take ownership of technical topics across the stack.

The position combines hands-on development with architecture, code quality and knowledge sharing in a collaborative environment.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Role
• Design, develop and maintain scalable web applications with PHP & Symfony at the core.
• Contribute to system architecture and solution design, focusing on security, performance, scalability and maintainability.
• Develop APIs and integrations, including asynchronous communication patterns.
• Work across the stack on backend services with PHP/Symfony and frontend features with Vue.js.
• Implement automated testing and collaborate on GitLab CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Profile
• You have 10+ years of experience as a Full Stack or Backend Engineer.
• You have strong expertise in PHP & Symfony and a solid understanding of web architecture, design patterns and best practices.
• You are comfortable with MySQL/PostgreSQL, caching solutions and asynchronous or distributed systems concepts.
• You have experience with GitLab CI/CD, modern DevOps practices and Docker.
• You have experience with automated testing and bring strong problem-solving skills in collaborative, agile environments.
• You communicate confidently in English.
• Knowledge of TypeScript, Vue.js or Python is considered an asset.

Talencia is currently looking for a Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist for one of their important clients, leader on the market. You will join a highly skilled and innovative team where collaboration, expertise, and growth are part of the culture.

Your role

• Investigate and respond to advanced security incidents: malware analysis, IoC extraction, forensic investigations, breach analysis
• Manage and resolve client requests while coordinating incident, change, and use-case tickets
• Take ownership of end-to-end response activities; from detection and analysis to reporting and recommendations
• Support customers with readiness assessments, audits, and tailored consultancy
• Contribute to the wider cybersecurity community and share knowledge at industry events
• Dedicate time each month to self-learning and technical exploration
• 
Ensure strict compliance with data protection, security frameworks, and best practices

 

What you bring

• At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, preferably in incident response
• Strong analytical, forensic, and problem-solving skills
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English
• Organized, detail-oriented, with strong reporting and documentation habits
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor junior colleagues
• Passion for continuous learning in a fast-evolving field

New year, new challenges!Join a structured manufacturing company in Brussels where you can grow professionally, improve your skills, and make an impact.

Our partner, a leadingmanufacturing company in Belgium, is looking for aSystem Administratorto join their IT team of talented engineers. 

 

A multicultural environment where you will be coached and trained, all while applying your technical expertise to real-world challenges.
System Administrator - Your Job
• Administer and maintain Windows servers, Microsoft 365, and on-premises IT infrastructure.
• Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize network devices (firewalls, switches, routers) and VPN connections.
• Install, configure, and maintain workstations, business applications, and IT equipment.
• Manage user accounts, permissions, and security policies in Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
• Support IT projects, system upgrades, and infrastructure improvements.
• Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity policies are up to date.
• Document IT procedures, contribute to continuous improvement, and maintain SLA compliance.
System Administrator - Your Profile
• 3 to 5 years of experience in IT infrastructure or system administration roles.
• Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365.
• Basic to intermediate networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, firewalls).
• Familiarity with backup solutions, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and cybersecurity best practices.
• Customer-focused, proactive, and problem-solving mindset.
• Able to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
• Fluent in English and French. Dutch is a plus.

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.

• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.

• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.

• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.

• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.

• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.

• Fluent in English

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

As Warehouse Operator, you will execute in an accurate manner tasks concerning both the physical handling and administration aspect of goods that are received, stocked, delivered to internal customers and shipped to external contacts.

The assignment

• Make sure that goods are stored and registered in the appropriate location

• Stock counts

• Check stock of standard goods in the cleanroom and ensure sufficient and timely supply within shelf life and register accordingly

• Deliver goods to cleanroom upon request of internal customers and register accordingly

• Receive goods from internal customers, pack, label and ship to external location taking into account applicable legislation

• You work efficiently, accurately and neatly and have an eye for safety.

• You are energetic, not afraid of physical work and have a great sense of responsibility.

• Your team spirit guarantees a flexible working arrangement.

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good knowledge of English.

• A certificate for operation of an electric stacker and forklift driving license is a plus.

• You preferably have several years of experience in administrative processing, experience with SAP is a plus.

Do you enjoy working with machines and have a technical, hands-on mindset? Are you detail-oriented and do you like to roll up your sleeves and get to work? Then this position as a die-cutter/machine setter in Sint-Amands might be right for you.
 

As a machine setter, you’ll be responsible for die-cutting boxes. You’ll set up the die-cutting machine, monitor the production process, and perform quality checks. In addition, you’ll carry out precision mechanical tasks and ensure that the finished products are properly stacked, sorted, or packaged.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• You’ll be responsible for setting up and monitoring the production process using the die-cutting machine. 

• You check the quality of the pieces. 

• You stack, sort, or package the finished product. 

• Additionally, you perform various precision mechanical tasks. 

• You ensure that operations run smoothly. 
 

• You speak and understand English well. 

• You have technical insight and/or have completed a technical education. 

• You are capable of performing physically demanding work. 

• You want to work in a production environment.

jobs.description:
Card Payments Team within a Belgian bank. Modernization and enhancement of card products and services.

Work arrangements: Full-time, 2 to 3 days of remote per week
Key responsibilities

• 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken - Must have

• 
French and/or Dutch - Nice to have

• 
Experience as a Product Owner or within Agile frameworks - Nice to have

• 
Exposure to Wero, digital wallets, and card system architecture - Nice to have

Forum is looking for Operators in Zottegem urgently! 
Your responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for setting up, operating, and reconfiguring production equipment on a production line.
• You will be able to work on various machines.
• You will clean the machines, equipment, and conveyor belts.
• You will be responsible for quality control.
• You will work in two shifts, Monday through Friday (6:00 AM–2:00 PM and 2:00 PM–10:00 PM).

Who are you?

• You have a technical background, either through a degree or work experience
• You have some initial experience as a technical operator
• You are motivated
• You have a consistent work history
• You speak English well
